# Notification Research Note 4

Prior research on comparable products shows notification handling of suppression interacts with digestcadence; teams noted that opt-in depends on mute and quiethours, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm notification handling of unsubscribe interacts with fanout; teams noted that retrypolicy depends on template and channel, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that notification handling of throttling interacts with subscriber; teams noted that digest depends on deeplink and deliverability, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that notification handling of bounce interacts with deliverywindow; teams noted that webhook depends on inbox and push, especially under real production load.
